text:
maya: Hey folks — quick check on mercury13b weights location and a couple of pre-onboard items.

maya: I found HF model id `mercury/mercury13b-v1` but unclear if we've mirrored to s3. Does registry-bot have a manifest? need checksum + ACLs before we hand to serving.

registry-bot: Manifest found: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/mercury13b/v1/manifest.json :eyes:
registry-bot: We have `weights.pt` (sha256: 8f3b2c9a6d4e1b2f9a3c7d2e1a9f4b6c3d2e1f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6) and tokenizer files. Presigned URLs can be generated.

alex: ACL note — the S3 prefix is currently private to infra-service-account. I'll add `ml-ingest` read role. presign TTL default is 2h, can bump if needed. planning to add role by EOD.

jun: quick tokenizer sanity: HF tokenizer is byte-level BPE but our serving expects `mercury-tokenizer.json` with `vocab_size=50276`. HF release shows `vocab_size=50280`. That difference breaks our tokenizer-check in CI.

jun: easy patch: run token normalization step or use our compatibility mapping. Run:
```
python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('mercury/mercury13b-v1'); print(t.vocab_size, t.model_max_length)"
```

sasha: Also please add the model config to registry `models.yaml` with quantization-friendly tags. I'll need the final checksum for the dedicated onboarding ticket.

maya: Thanks — action items:
- alex: add `ml-ingest` read ACL + confirm presign TTL :+1:
- jun: run tokenizer sanity, produce mapping if vocab mismatch :mag:
- sasha: reserve model entry and add tags
- maya: will verify checksum after ACL changes and kick off canary rollout

maya: pinging @alex @jun @sasha — PLs reply inline when done. :calendar:

alex: on it, will confirm here when role is added.

jun: running sanity now — see results in ~10m.

registry-bot: presign (example): `https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-artifacts/models/mercury13b/v1/weights.pt?X-Amz-Expires=7200`

maya: perfect, thanks all :tada:
